intent.description: Diagnose one concrete enterprise AI or digital-transformation process from an evidence pack, workflow card, interview synthesis, or bounded process materials. Use when an AI implementation practitioner must verify demand reality, preserve evidence conflicts, choose the minimum sufficient combination of process redesign, rules, API, workflow, RPA, AI workflow, RAG, bounded Agent, and human work, determine whether implementation is developable, conditional, or blocked, and produce an internal diagnosis plus a client-facing 3-7 day shadow pilot. Do not use to merely organize raw materials, interview an employee, audit an entire enterprise, directly implement a settled solution, or recommend tools without process evidence and system conditions.

output_contract: Primary business conclusion, confidence, and technical maturity
Restated business problem and current process
Evidence ledger, contradictions, and prohibited conclusions
System/interface discovery card with evidence status
Conditional technical plan and per-component `可开发/有条件/阻塞` state
Risks, permission boundary, maintenance responsibility, and internal deal advice

Recommended route in plain business language
Confirmed prerequisites and conditions still requiring client verification
3-7 day shadow pilot, acceptance measures, and client participants
Responsibilities, exclusions, risks, and next decision gate
